messages:
elaine: opened a PR to clarify Lumen-5B behavior around server-side batching, per-request limits, and retry semantics. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13199
sam: important - customers see silent truncation when batching + streaming. can we clearly call out "limits are per-request" and how batching aggregates at the infra level only?
marco: ran microbench for batched generate vs single-shot. gist: https://gist.github.com/marco/lumen5b-batch-bench 
elaine: dropping the example snippets here for reviewers. python batch example (sdk v2):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=\"$REDWOOD_KEY\")
# batching multiple prompts in one call for throughput
res = client.generate_batch(model=\"lumen-5b\", requests=[{"prompt":"A..."},{"prompt":"B..."}], max_tokens=200)
for r in res:
    print(r.text)
```
sam: add a small note about retry headers: when the service returns 429 with `Retry-After`, SDK will retry once with jitter; recommend idempotency for non-idempotent prompts or use dedupe keys.
elaine: added a short "Retries & throttling" section and SDK snippet for checking response headers. js example added too:
```javascript
const res = await client.generateBatch({ model: 'lumen-5b', requests: [ { prompt: 'A...' }, { prompt: 'B...' } ], max_tokens: 200 })
res.forEach(r => console.log(r.text))
```
anya: infra requests we add explicit text: "Per-request token limits (max_total_tokens) are enforced per entry in a batched call, not per-batch aggregate." helps reduce confusion.
rik: runtime side: add compat note for cpu-quant fallback: "cpu-quant recommended up to 4096; batched requests increase memory pressure because each request holds its own kv cache". asked to include YAML fallback policy example.
marco: added compact perf blurb (measured at 1k tokens): "gpu-fp p50 90ms (130 tps), gpu-quant p50 115ms (95 tps), cpu-quant (4k) p50 1200ms (6 tps)"
olivia: product wants a one-line caution under Examples: "Avoid large batches with high max_tokens to prevent OOMs on shared cpu-quant backends."
elaine: included error-handling snippet showing check for 413 and 429 and client-side token-count suggestion. snippet:
```python
try:
  res = client.generate(...)
except ApiError as e:
  if e.status_code == 413:
    print('Reduce max_tokens or split request')
  if e.status_code == 429:
    print('Respect Retry-After header or reduce concurrency')
```
marco: fixed a broken anchor in the model-variants section that link-checker flagged (/models/lumen-5b/variants). added frontmatter redirect.
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR 13199: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/13199  link-checker: 1 warning -> vendor-gh-gist links external (ok).
sam: tiny copy edit: change "generate_batch" -> "generate_batch (server-side batching)" and add note: "use stream for interactive single-request flows".
elaine: merging after anya confirms redirect change and CI green. thanks team!
anya: redirect + link-check green. LGTM from infra.
docs-bot: merged PR 13199. changelog updated. closing thread. :tada:
